one_line: AI spending, deals, research, and model updates dominate the day.

themes.title: China ramps AI spending
themes.text: China's biggest tech firms plan to double AI infrastructure capex to $139 bn in 2026, while revenue from AI labs covers less than 8%, indicating financing pressure amid US chip restrictions.

stories.headline: China's top tech firms face growing financial gap in AI build-out

themes.title: AI-driven corporate acquisitions
themes.text: Amazon is in advanced talks to buy AI startup Decart for about $7.5 bn to strengthen AWS, and Ubisoft launched Motherbrain studio to build AI-powered smart NPCs for its games.

stories.headline: Amazon close to $7.5bn acquisition of AI startup Decart
Ubisoft creates Motherbrain studio to develop AI-driven smart NPCs

themes.title: AI advances in research
themes.text: Researchers used AI to produce a Navier‑Stokes blowup proof, while Google pledged $5 m to IIT Kharagpur for advanced AI research, and experts noted current models still need human collaboration for complex problems.

stories.headline: Researchers publish AI-aided Navier-Stokes blowup proof
Google announces $5M funding for IIT Kharagpur for advanced AI research
Ethan Mollick: AI models cannot yet solve complex problems alone

themes.title: New models and cost rise
themes.text: Mistral AI released Voxtral 3 speech models and a voice‑agent SDK with sub‑second latency, and DeepMind’s Gemini 4 Hydrogen model showed a cost increase to 23.61 cents per request in xhigh thinking effort mode.

stories.headline: Mistral releases Voxtral 3 speech models and voice agent SDK
Gemini 4 Hydrogen cost jumps with xhigh thinking effort mode
